items.title: Close M4 process fact registry coverage
items.context: Verify all gate-consumed facts introduced or relied on by M4-M12 are registered in process-fact-registry/process-fact-levels and covered by verify-process-fact-contract.
items.userSees: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs and parent_roadmap_status show M4 closed with evidence refs.

happy.desc: Process fact registry coverage closes only when the process fact contract verifier and parent roadmap status both prove registry coverage for the strengthened gate facts.

edge.desc: M4 must not be closed by documentation text alone; parent-roadmap machine status must carry evidence refs.

adversarial.desc: M4 must preserve claim boundaries, especially retired Authority Server semantics and read-only/advisory surfaces.

items.title: Close M5 verification context pack and evidence envelope standardization
items.context: Verify context pack and evidence manifest/envelope behavior covers changed refs, digests, expansion, stale/missing cases, and reviewer/validator consumption boundaries.

items.title: Close M6 gate oracle freshness and negative-control matrix
items.context: Verify canonical DONE/readiness oracle rows, freshness handling, and expected-block negative controls for lifecycle and receipt paths.

items.title: Close M7 baseline suite formalization
items.context: Verify baseline_run, baseline_suite, reports, outcome math, false-DONE accounting, and claim boundaries satisfy roadmap baseline requirements.

items.title: Close M8 host identity review-run and 3x2 quorum strengthening
items.context: Verify host/session/key/material/validation binding, 3x2 and degraded 3x1 behavior, ignored verdict reasons, and review escalation DONE consumption.

items.title: Close M9 preflight command center
items.context: Verify lifecycle_orchestrate/session/status surfaces consume canonical readiness rows and render next actions without mutating evidence or widening assurance.

items.title: Close M10 parallel collaboration scheduling
items.context: Verify parallel wave, decomposition, dispatch policy, owner lease, hotspot/dependency and read-only scheduling boundaries satisfy roadmap scheduling requirements.

items.title: Close M11 rollout migration and operator guidance
items.context: Verify rollout_check, compatibility policy, repair/runbook guidance, and in-flight story treatment are documented and tested for M4-M10 closure.

items.title: Close M12 cross-track certification and handoff package
items.context: Verify final cross-track certification composes M4-M11 evidence, handoff/evidence manifests, quorum, and claim boundary without authority overclaim.
